translations.web: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.
translations.bsb: You have given us up as sheep to be devoured; You have scattered us among the nations.
translations.kjv: Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.
translations.asv: Thou hast made us like sheep appointed for food, And hast scattered us among the nations.
